fields.could_fail: if burial were not the confound, matching on it would leave the uncontrolled gap intact
fields.label: burial-matched pairing within complex
fields.observed: the uncontrolled gap of +0.105 collapses to -0.043 once burial, secondary structure and packing are matched

fields.could_fail: an effect surviving exact residue matching would not be composition
fields.label: amino-acid identity matched pairs
fields.observed: the monomer deficit falls from -0.442 to -0.012 on exactly AA-matched pairs

fields.could_fail: a gap smaller than the order spread would not be a result, per BRIEF section 5.6
fields.label: decoding-order spread on the estimate
fields.observed: the primary estimate spans [+0.129, +0.475], SD 0.119, and the estimate is about 2.8 times its own order spread

fields.could_fail: a sign flip between conditional and unconditional would mean the result is an artifact of the autoregressive order
fields.label: order-free unconditional score
fields.observed: +0.382 against the conditional +0.334, and -0.090 against -0.043 on SECONDARY-B
fields.varies: scoring mode: backbone-only single pass, no sequence context

fields.could_fail: a checkpoint-dependent conclusion would not be a property of the recipe
fields.label: sigma = 0.02 checkpoint replicate
fields.observed: no variant on either checkpoint shows the hypothesised penalty and the highest-powered variant sits at zero on both

fields.could_fail: a result present in one architecture only would be a property of that model
fields.label: four-architecture panel
fields.observed: in 3 of 4 models every tier's CI contains zero, and the two exceptions point in opposite directions

fields.could_fail: a nonzero spread across repeat calls would mean the decoding-order argument does not hold by construction
fields.label: PiFold determinism
fields.observed: max |delta| = 0.0 across repeat calls and seeds

fields.could_fail: a hotspot-specific constellation cost would show up as a nonzero median difference
fields.label: N_hot at burial-matched control constellations
fields.varies: constellation: hotspot positions against matched controls

fields.could_fail: a secondary-structure assignment that cannot recover a known all-alpha protein is not usable
fields.label: validation gate positive controls
fields.observed: 87% H on 1MBN, 84% E on 1TEN, SASA agrees with freesasa to 0.000%, D39A comes out at +6.79 kcal/mol
fields.varies: known-answer fixtures: 1MBN all-alpha, 1TEN all-beta, 1CSE bound against free, barnase-barstar D39A

fields.could_fail: disagreement in the unambiguous classes would invalidate the interface definition the whole experiment rests on
fields.label: SKEMPI COR/SUP/RIM cross-check of the interface definition
fields.observed: 67/67 COR called interface, 37/37 INT and 49/49 SUR called non-interface
